title: Step-Down Points of Serious Violations: Method of Calculation (Seller Performance Standing)
content:
**Method.** The points carried at the step-down are the points recorded for serious violations whose first period has run, less every point already expired, relieved or reversed on entries carrying a serious type, and never less than zero. The step-down is the carried points multiplied by the step-down share of 0.125 and rounded down to a whole point, and it never exceeds the step-down cap of 2 points or the carried points. The product is worked to four decimal places before it is rounded down.

Serious violations on a Seller Performance Standing record are intellectual property, inauthentic complaint, product authenticity and review manipulation violations. A serious violation's first period has run when six or more whole calendar months have passed from its recording date to the handling date, counted by calendar date; a serious violation recorded in the last six whole calendar months has not reached that point.

## Elements

| Element | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Serious points whose first period has run | points recorded for serious violations from which six or more whole months have passed |
| Less | every point on points-expiry entries (expiries, step-downs, reliefs) and reversal entries carrying any serious type |
| Carried points | the difference, never less than zero |
| Share-applied points | carried points multiplied by 0.125, to four decimal places, rounded down |
| Step-down | share-applied points, held at 2 and at the carried points, whichever is lower |

## Worked figures (hypothetical records, handling date 15 September)

1. An intellectual property violation of 8 points recorded on 10 February and a review manipulation violation of 16 points recorded on 1 August. Only the first has run its first period: carried points 8. 8 multiplied by 0.125 is 1.0000, rounded down to 1. The step-down is 1 point.
2. Two serious violations of 16 points each, both recorded more than six whole months ago, with a reversal of 8 points carrying a serious type: carried points 24. 24 multiplied by 0.125 is 3.0000, rounded down to 3; held at 2. The step-down is 2 points.
3. An inauthentic complaint violation of 8 points recorded seven months ago, with 8 points already expired on an entry carrying a serious type: carried points 0, and the step-down is 0.
